item.title: SECOND WEEK OF WINTER CLEANUP CONTINUES IN HENDERSON COUNTY AS CREWS BATTLE FRIGID WINDS
item.description: In Henderson County, from the North Carolina Department of Transportation to private contractor crews, it was the second week of winter weather cleanup. To give crews more time to make primary and secondary roadways passable, both Henderson County and Hendersonville have closed government offices on Monday, Feb. 2, for non-essential workers. item.title: CITY OF HENDERSONVILLE TO HOLD TRANSPORTATION BOND REFERENDUM ON MARCH 3, 2026
item.description: City of Hendersonville voters will consider a Transportation General Obligation (GO) Bond referendum during the March 3, 2026, primary election. If approved, the referendum would authorize the City to issue up to $10 million in General Obligation bonds to fund transportation infrastructure improvements.
